name: Eaton Vance Municipal Income 2028 Term Trust Common Shares of Beneficial Interest
summary: The Eaton Vance Municipal Income 2028 Term Trust is a closed-end mutual fund, initiated and actively managed by Eaton Vance Management. This fund primarily allocates capital to fixed-income instruments, with a particular focus on generating municipal income. It was established on March 28, 2013, within the United States. Prior to its current designation, the trust operated under the name Eaton Vance Municipal Income Term Trust.
